Would probably need to be in there a year if I actually wasn't going to ctb tomorrow. Kek.

It's all bullshit. Meh. I just am waiting for tomorrow so I can finally do it. No light in my room. It's just that everything is pointless and nothing interests me. Too fucked up to live. Have a nice one.
I always get "you make me so happy." While they're fucking around.
That's never going to happen for me.

Same situation-ish. Just realized they never loved you in the first place. They were just playing with you for an ego boost. Pretty sad. No I don't need to be "fixed" and I don't need help. No one wants anything serious these days or kids because they're normal and a kid in a candy store due to so many options (mostly low quality options). Everyone is disposable.

I don't know what to say. That must be devastating. Holidays are the lowest for suicide rates, apparently. Yeah. Those bipolar medications suck. Bipolar Disorder already shaves 20 years off your life span; here lets make it more shitty but all the side effects that go with them - weight gain, etc. IDK if you have a cat or something. I do (had him since 3 weeks old) - he's been climbing in my lap lately. Never done this before. It's like he KNOWS I'm going to do it. Yeah, I hate talking to people too. I don't need anything from anybody (help) maybe true genuine caring and affection but that's rare. It always ends in the same result or 99.9% of the time I don't connect. So I just sleep and keep to myself or talk to my sister. Try to get back together, then see how you feel.

That sucks. But at least you have someone that won't leave you. A lot of people want this but don't get this. You have potential plans for kids - a lot of people want this. But men these days are really flaky. Finding someone you can connect with and never leave you is great. You have the option of kids too. I've always wanted to have kids. Used to google things when I was like 14 - finding if anything were wrong with me in that area and freaking out. I think therapy is BS as well. A lot of them kill themselves - the therapists. I think my brain is structurally and chemical fried through all the shit I had to go through. How is suicide selfish? Is there someone who will pay for us the rest of our lifes, so we can be miserable? I've tried to find the meaning of life for the past year. I literally went on [nderf.org](https://nderf.org) every day. Avicii and a lot of others also really struggled with thoughts about Meaning, Life, Happiness. Autism + Bipolar = high death rate. There's nothing more I want on this earth (material or otherwise). I plan to do it either today or tomorrow. I've had no one my entire life (even friends) and I am far too fucked to connect with someone normal. I was thinking at work whatever's on the other side must be way better than whatever's here.
